name: Controls > Modes offers and writes AUX 1 to AUX 13 only
step: Check the Modes AUX channel range
rationale:
Issue #2749: the AUX channel picker on Controls > Modes offered AUX 1 to AUX 20, and the mode range write did not clamp the index. The firmware's MAX_AUX_CHANNEL_COUNT is 13 (18 - 5). A mode range reads rcInput[auxChannelIndex + CONTROL_CHANNEL_COUNT] without a check (rc_modes.h), and MSP_SET_MODE_RANGE stores the index as sent (msp.c), so an index above 12 reads past rcInput[].

The page now offers 13 channels and the auto-detect scans the same 13, and msp_modes.lua clamps the mode range's AUX index to 0..12 on write, as msp_adjustments.lua does since #2747. Mode ranges have no always-on choice, so 255 is clamped too.

The harness pins the clamp on the real codec (AUX 14 and AUX 21 written as AUX 13, AUX 1 and AUX 13 unchanged, 255 clamped) and reads the page's picker count from its source. --self-test removes the clamp and requires the clamp check to go red.
